# Critical Strike Rating & Critical Strike Damage per Mana consumed recently (Tyrant's Iron Fist)

- **Status:** ⚠️ Unverified
- **Mechanic tags:** legendary, consumption-subsystem, crit, tick-rounding, damage-pool

## Notes / caveats / open questions

Sourced from the item's own affix text and a mod_parser round-trip test — NOT yet confirmed against an in-game crit-rating/crit-damage reading. Open questions for an in-game test: (1) does the +5%/+5% actually apply per-880-900-chunk floored the way `floored_consumed` models it, or does it interpolate continuously; (2) is the roll midpoint-per-unit divisor (`X/100 / midpoint(N1,N2)`) the correct in-game math, or does the game compute per-stack differently; (3) whether there is an unstated cap the item text omits (every other 'for every N consumed recently' affix seen so far either states a cap or doesn't -- Tyrant's Iron Fist's raw text has no cap clause, which the parser honors as uncapped, but that absence should be confirmed, not assumed). A second, presumably crafted/upgraded variant of the same affix at `_legendary_gear.json:68516` reads "+5 % ... for every (700-725) Mana consumed recently" (tighter divisor, same modifier shape) -- same open questions apply there. Do not promote to `confirmed`/`partial` without a recorded in-game measurement.

## Implementation (engine model)

Modeled as an additive INCREASE into two separate pools — the Crit Rating % pool and the Crit Damage additive pool (each is one summed multiplier, not its own MORE group). `mod_parser.py:625-628` parses "+X % Critical Strike Rating and Critical Strike Damage for every (N1-N2) Mana consumed recently" into four stat rows: `crit_rating_inc_per_mana_consumed`, `crit_dmg_inc_per_mana_consumed` (both = X/100 / midpoint(N1,N2)), and `crit_rating_inc_per_mana_consumed_unit` / `crit_dmg_inc_per_mana_consumed_unit` (both = midpoint(N1,N2)). No cap parsed for this affix (contrast with e.g. Compensatory Life's Mana-Regen-per-consumed affix, which does carry a `_cap` suffix). Both halves are now folded in-loop in compute.py, the same way. `compute.py:929-947`, inside the consumption loop (alongside the Compensatory Life / Tide of the Styx per-consumed folds), injects `floored_consumed(consumed_recently_mana, crit_dmg_inc_per_mana_consumed_unit) * crit_dmg_inc_per_mana_consumed` directly into the real `crit_dmg_inc` pool via `source.add_with_source("crit_dmg_inc", ...)`, so it's summed by offense.py's `_CRIT_DMG_STATS` and shows a labeled source in the crit-multiplier breakdown. `compute.py:949-968` does the mirrored fold for the Crit Rating side, immediately below the Crit Damage block: it injects `floored_consumed(consumed_recently_mana, crit_rating_inc_per_mana_consumed_unit) * crit_rating_inc_per_mana_consumed` into the real `crit_rating_inc` pool via `source.add_with_source("crit_rating_inc", ...)`, so it's summed by offense.py's `_CRIT_RATING_INC_STATS` and shows a labeled source in the crit-rating breakdown. `offense.py:1615-1616` (`crit_damage = sum(source.total(key) for key, tags in _CRIT_DMG_STATS ...)`; `crit_mult = 1.5 + crit_damage`) and `offense.py:1585-1586` (`crit_rating_inc = sum(source.total(k) for k, tags in _CRIT_RATING_INC_STATS ...)`; `raw_csr = (base_csr + weapon_csr + other_csr) * (1.0 + crit_rating_inc)`) now just consume their already-folded pools — the standalone post-loop folds that used to live at offense.py for both halves (previously cited as offense.py:1610-1617 for Crit Damage, offense.py:1583-1588 for Crit Rating) have both been deleted; nothing at either location performs a fold anymore. Both the compute.py and offense.py reads use `engine.consumption.floored_consumed` (`consumption.py:36-42`), which quantizes `consumed_recently_mana` DOWN to a whole multiple of the rolled unit (e.g. at unit=890, only whole 890-Mana chunks count — a partial chunk grants nothing) — this floor-to-discrete-stacks behavior itself is Tyra-confirmed as the correct engine convention for "for every N consumed recently" affixes generally, but that confirmation is about the shared `floored_consumed` mechanism, not an in-game measurement of THIS item's numbers. `consumed_recently_mana` is a Stage-B rolling total (`consumption.py`): `consumed_per_sec x RECENTLY_WINDOW_S` (4.0 s, Tyra-confirmed window), summed across the build's self-consume mana-drain affixes (Mana Boil-style effects) — it is NOT the skill's intrinsic mana cost. If a build has no mana-consume source, `consumed_recently_mana` is 0 and this affix contributes nothing, which is correct but means Tyrant's Iron Fist requires pairing with an active mana-consume affix to do anything at all.
